# NERM endpoint index

Every operation in SailPoint's NERM OpenAPI specs, by tag. Details (parameters, body wrapper, response): `endpoints.md`. Base URL of each version is given in its heading; the tenant is the one in your browser URL (`https://{tenant}.nonemployee.com`), never `{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`.
